title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Agnee Prem
desc: The film is a love story between a rich girl and middle class boy. The girls stepmother is against the alliance so they run away. they are helped by a lawyer. The girls father sends a hired killer to finish he boy but the killer is under the impression that the boy is characterless. He finds out the truth in time and then helps the lovers.

title: Chhoti Si Baat
desc: Plot. Chhoti Si Baat is a romantic comedy about a painfully shy young man Arun Pradeep (Amol Palekar), who lacks self-confidence and fails to stand up for his convictions, in the process letting all and sundry walk all over him.
